notes_for_editor: Agency, county and the sale are supported by two sources. The Random Connections post gives no year in the text read; the 2010 sale date comes only from the Forest Lookouts page. No source found gives a build date, design, staffing or fire history. The buyer was to remove the tower, so it may have moved, but no source says so. The Columbia Metropolitan and SCFC lines are statewide context, not specific to Silverton. The Random Connections post hedges its claim ('It seems that the South Carolina Forestry Commission is selling...'), and the story keeps that hedge. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the Silverton, Random Connections, Columbia Metropolitan and SCFC quotes were checked against their pages; four sentences were corrected.
